subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is the value of the digit </mtext><mn>5</mn><mtext> in the number </mtext><mn>357</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of each digit in 357.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: 3 is in the hundreds place, 5 is in the tens place, 7 is in the ones place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: The digit 5 is in the tens place, so its value is 5 tens.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 50</mtext></mrow></math>
